description:
We are looking for a PowerCenter / Java Developer with experience in Informatica PowerCenter and Java to join a technology project involving data integration, application development, and Cloud environments.
 You will join a technical team and work autonomously on the development, maintenance, and enhancement of applications and data integration processes. You will also collaborate closely with technical teams and users in an international environment.
 Key Responsibilities
 Develop, maintain, and enhance data integration and data processing solutions using Informatica PowerCenter.
 Design, develop, and maintain workflows, mappings, and ETL processes.
 Develop and maintain applications and components using Java.
 Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to existing applications and processes.
 Contribute to the evolution and modernization of applications toward Cloud environments, primarily Microsoft Azure.
 Integrate applications and processes with other systems, databases, and services.
 Participate throughout the full software development lifecycle, including analysis, development, testing, deployment, and support.
 Collaborate with technical and functional teams, as well as users, to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
 Participate in follow-up meetings and technical discussions in English when required.
  

  
 At least 2 years of professional experience working with both Java and Informatica PowerCenter.
 Proven hands-on experience in development projects using Informatica PowerCenter.
 Practical knowledge of ETL processes, data integration, and data transformation.
 Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
 Experience with projects or applications deployed in Cloud environments.
 Knowledge of or experience with Microsoft Azure.
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
 Minimum B2 level of English, with the ability to communicate effectively with users and international teams.
 Nice to Have 
 Azure services related to application development and integration, such as Azure Functions, App Service, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, or Azure DevOps.
 Development or consumption of REST APIs.
 Git and version control tools.
 Deployment automation.
 Agile/Scrum methodologies.
 Experience working in complex corporate environments, preferably within the financial or banking sector.
 
 What do we offer you? 
 Full-time or B2B contract
 Remote within CET Time zone.  
 Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.
  
 If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you !
